gameplan.macro_context: Today's session is dominated by the FOMC press release (intraday, ~2:00 PM ET) — a binary, high-volatility event that makes pre-decision directional positioning unreliable; the historical calibration explicitly flags FOMC days as accuracy-degrading for bias calls. Looking ahead, the Employment Situation (NFP) prints in 6 days on July 2, meaning any hawkish FOMC surprise today will be compounded by uncertainty around labor data next week, keeping risk premium elevated through month-end.
gameplan.gamma_summary: SPY is in positive gamma just above the 728 flip, which should dampen intraday swings and create a gravitational pull toward max pain at 734 pre-FOMC — but that dynamic evaporates instantly on a large post-decision move. QQQ is in deeply negative gamma (-2.83B net) with spot wedged between multiple put walls at 705-707; dealers here amplify directional moves, meaning any post-FOMC breakout in QQQ — up or down — runs farther and faster than the market expects. IWM sits a whisker below the dominant 300 call wall (1.51B GEX), creating a pinning/ceiling effect pre-FOMC that resolves sharply once the decision lands.
